planets.name: WASP-65 b
planets.description: Transiting planet of WASP-65 with a 2.31-day year, found in 2013.

text.card: WASP-65 b was found in 2013 by SuperWASP as it crossed its star.
text.introduction: It is the only planet known around WASP-65. Its orbit and size follow Gomez et al. 2013's fit, the archive's default.
text.locator: NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table, default parameter set (pl_refname GOMEZ_ET_AL__2013): disc_year 2013, disc_facility SuperWASP, sy_pnum 1; pl_orbper 2.3114205, pl_radj 1.112, pl_bmassj 1.55

thermal.source: Deming et al. 2023, dayside brightness temperature at 3.6 µm (uniform reanalysis of Spitzer's eclipses, CDS J/AJ/165/104 table 2)
thermal.chosen: 2 measured of 2 rows; the smallest relative uncertainty, then the longest wavelength
